faqList.headerText: Will your developers be available to have a meeting in my time zone?
faqList.description: One of the main reasons to outsource is to work round-the-clock and that too, at a better cost than hiring in-house staff. We generally work from 10 AM to 7 PM IST (Mon - Fri); however, for the call/meeting, hired developers can make adjustments for around +/- 3 hours from regular office hours.
